cases.title: Home (My day rail) renders empty state for a new workspace: "Nothing due today", no stale deals
Campaigns list empty state: "No campaigns yet" + Create New Campaign button works
Campaign analytics (Dashboard) empty workspace: zeros not NaN, range buttons render
Home My day rail lists a due task; ticking it marks it DONE in the DB and removes it
Campaigns list shows every campaign with correct status badge and prospect count (matches DB)
Search filters rows (server-side, debounced) and clearing restores; no-match shows empty state
Column picker toggles columns, persists in localStorage across reload, Reset restores defaults
Row Pause on ACTIVE campaign -> PAUSED (DB + badge), Resume -> ACTIVE
Delete: cancelling the confirm keeps the campaign; accepting removes it (UI + DB)
Row click: DRAFT opens the wizard in edit mode, ACTIVE opens details (View icon is lg:hidden)
Select-all + bulk bar: Pause selected (confirm) pauses active campaigns in DB; clear selection
Pause API failure surfaces feedback to the user (not silent)
Campaigns list: API 500 shows an explicit error (not the empty state)
Dashboard shows real totals for the workspace (campaign count, status breakdown) consistent with DB
Dashboard range buttons (Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Yearly) change the chart without errors; alerts bell opens
Dashboard campaign table lists campaigns; rows and "View Campaigns" navigate
Dashboard API failure (global-analytics/dashboard-summary 500) degrades without crash
MANAGER sees the campaigns list and can open a campaign (manage_campaigns)
AGENT without view_analytics: no Campaign analytics link, URL redirects Home, no 403 calls
